Walls: reads tape only, writes reports/ only; atlas.yaml/manager/ engines hash-checked byte-identical per run; no book -> cost-unknown excluded (never estimated); invalidated politics rows out; scorecard lanes labeled pending-verdict — adoption knock only for verdict-passed lanes (none yet).
